page.layout: One printed page (left page not present; the right-hand page is the text page with running head and page number at top). At the right edge, a narrow strip of show-through/margin text from the facing page, not transcribed.

main_text.p: Genii nostri, Ducatu, quem malis artibus sibi sumserant, abire nondum decreverunt: Quin potius in Academiis, ubi magno passim apparatu, magnâ pompâ, iter instruitur ad Veritatem, Doctores se ambitiosè Ductoresque profitentur; Sed ampla quædam polliciti, deludunt credulos: &, cum sponte suâ cupidam juventutem, tum speciosis promissis vehementer illectam, abducunt in Laqueos & in avia. De Sensu quidem accepimus: olim eum Epicuro patrono, ridiculos in casses impulisse, quem pascebat gregem: Dicebant Epicurei, nunquam Sensum fallere; sæpe Rationem delirare: proinde, si quid certi vellemus amplecti, abeundum a Ratione, & standum esse cum Seusu: Interrogati, num igitur Sol in ortu major esset, minor in meridie (id enim Videndi Sensus
